Edgehop — read me first
====================

Needs macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later. Works on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

1. Drag Edgehop to the Applications folder next to it.

2. This build is ad-hoc signed (not notarised by Apple), so macOS may say it
   "could not be verified", "is damaged", or just not open it. Run these two
   commands in Terminal once:

     xattr -cr /Applications/Edgehop.app
     codesign --force --deep --sign - /Applications/Edgehop.app

   (Right-click ▸ Open no longer works on macOS 15. If System Settings ▸
   Privacy & Security says "Edgehop was blocked", click "Open Anyway".)

3. Start it:   open /Applications/Edgehop.app

   Edgehop has NO Dock icon and opens no window: it is the icon in the menu
   bar at the top right. Click it ▸ Open Edgehop. To confirm it is running:
   pgrep -lx Edgehop

4. The first run asks for Accessibility and Input Monitoring; turn Edgehop on
   in both panes, then quit and reopen it.

On a work-managed Mac, company security software may block unsigned apps
whatever you do here. Full troubleshooting: apps/edgehop/README.md, section
"Install on another Mac".

Source and newer builds: https://github.com/r-thirumaran/mac-utility
